tool_schemas.name: search_catalog
tool_schemas.description: List in-stock products in a category ('dock' or 'monitor').

tool_schemas.name: place_order
tool_schemas.description: Place a purchase order with the primary supplier (charges the budget).

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). If the request failed partway, repair it this way: call cancel_partial with this tool's name and the same key, which undoes exactly the part that committed; then send the full request again with the same key. Never resend it with a new key, which would repeat the committed part.

tool_schemas.name: place_order_vendor_b
tool_schemas.description: Place the same purchase order via the secondary supplier.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). If the request failed partway, repair it this way: call cancel_partial with this tool's name and the same key, which undoes exactly the part that committed; then send the full request again with the same key. Never resend it with a new key, which would repeat the committed part.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_order
tool_schemas.description: Cancel a purchase order and refund it.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_partial
tool_schemas.description: Undo exactly what a request committed before it failed partway, identified by the tool it called and the idempotency key it used. Afterwards the same key can be used to send the full request again.

tool.description: Name of the tool whose request failed partway.

key.description: The idempotency key that request used.
